# Apache HTTPD (AJP) — root-context-sse

App at /, everything including PUSH proxied over AJP. WebSocket frames cannot ride AJP, so the WebSocket sibling needs a RewriteRule bypassing it to the backend HTTP port; over SSE the AJP worker carries push itself, with flushpackets=on so mod_proxy_ajp does not buffer the stream.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Apache HTTPD config (`vaadin.conf`):

```apache
# Everything, PUSH included, rides AJP. Note what is missing compared with
# ajp/root-context: there is no RewriteRule bypassing AJP to ws://vaadin:8080,
# and the backend's HTTP port is never contacted. WebSocket frames cannot be
# carried over AJP, but SSE is ordinary HTTP, so the AJP worker handles both
# directions of the push connection on its own.
#
# flushpackets=on is what makes it work: mod_proxy_ajp buffers the response by
# default, which would hold each SSE event back instead of passing it straight
# through.
ProxyPass         "/"      ajp://vaadin:8009/ flushpackets=on
ProxyPassReverse  "/"      ajp://vaadin:8009/
```
